reason: As someone who has quit diet apps and a meal service before, I trust A more. It says plainly that 14 people is a small, self-selected group and that medication changes weren't tracked. It also offers a 15-minute call with the dietitian and tells me the menu repeats every four weeks, which speaks to why I quit before. B is honest, but it puts the "10 went down" result in bold and leaves out the call, so I'm less sure about spending $59.
